title: การแข่งขันฟิสิกส์โอลิมปิกระดับชาติ ครั้งที่ 14 (TPhO 2558)
subject: ฟิสิกส์
level: โอลิมปิก (สอวน.)
note: 17 items: 13 from the three theory problems (2.2 ก is the process named in 2.2 ข; sketches and steps share items) and 4 theory parts of the saline lab with synthetic data. Every answer agrees with TPhO14_theory-solution.pdf and TPhO2015_Lab_Solution.pdf (recorded as ignored), except that the lab's per-drop volume 0.0235 ml should be 0.0240 ml.

items.title: มุมสูงสุดของประจุที่แกว่งในสนามไฟฟ้า
items.source: 1.1 ก: มุมสูงสุดของประจุที่แกว่งในสนามไฟฟ้า. Theory 1.1 (a) figure a: released from the vertical, the charge swings until the field's work qE l sin(theta) equals the rise in potential energy mgl(1 - cos theta), so tan(theta_m/2) = qE/mg and theta_m = 2 arctan(qE/mg). Adapted: the ratio qE/mg varies (charge in microcoulombs, E in kN/C, m in grams); returns theta_m in degrees.
items.figure: Theory 1.1 (a) figure a: released from the vertical, the charge swings until the field's work qE l sin(theta) equals the rise in potential energy mgl(1 - cos theta), so tan(theta_m/2) = qE/mg and theta_m = 2 arctan(qE/mg). Adapted: the ratio qE/mg varies (charge in microcoulombs, E in kN/C, m in grams); returns theta_m in degrees.

items.title: มุมสมดุลของประจุในสนามไฟฟ้า
items.source: 1.1 ข: มุมสมดุลของประจุในสนามไฟฟ้า. Theory 1.1 (b) figure b: at rest the tangential forces balance, mg sin(theta0) = qE cos(theta0), so theta0 = arctan(qE/mg). Adapted: q (microcoulombs), E (kN/C) and m (g) vary; returns theta0 in degrees.
items.figure: Theory 1.1 (b) figure b: at rest the tangential forces balance, mg sin(theta0) = qE cos(theta0), so theta0 = arctan(qE/mg). Adapted: q (microcoulombs), E (kN/C) and m (g) vary; returns theta0 in degrees.

items.title: ความถี่การสั่นของประจุในสนามไฟฟ้า
items.source: 1.1 ค: ความถี่การสั่นของประจุในสนามไฟฟ้า. Theory 1.1 (c): about theta0 the restoring force is -(mg cos theta0 + qE sin theta0) delta theta, so f = (1/2 pi) sqrt((mg cos theta0 + qE sin theta0)/(m l)) = (1/2 pi) sqrt(sqrt(g^2 + (qE/m)^2)/l). Adapted: q (microcoulombs), E (kN/C), m (g) and l (m) vary; returns f in Hz.
items.figure: Theory 1.1 (c): about theta0 the restoring force is -(mg cos theta0 + qE sin theta0) delta theta, so f = (1/2 pi) sqrt((mg cos theta0 + qE sin theta0)/(m l)) = (1/2 pi) sqrt(sqrt(g^2 + (qE/m)^2)/l). Adapted: q (microcoulombs), E (kN/C), m (g) and l (m) vary; returns f in Hz.

items.title: ระยะตุ้มถ่วงที่ทำให้คานหมุนเร็วที่สุด
items.source: 1.2 ก: ระยะตุ้มถ่วงที่ทำให้คานหมุนเร็วที่สุด. Theory 1.2 (a) figure: about the pivot the net torque is tau + mgl - MgL/2 on I = ML^2/3 + ml^2; d(alpha)/dl = 0 gives ml^2 + 2(tau/g - ML/2) l - ML^2/3 = 0, so l = [-(tau/g - ML/2) + sqrt((tau/g - ML/2)^2 + mML^2/3)]/m. Adapted: tau, M, L and m vary; returns l in metres with g = 9.8.
items.figure: Theory 1.2 (a) figure: about the pivot the net torque is tau + mgl - MgL/2 on I = ML^2/3 + ml^2; d(alpha)/dl = 0 gives ml^2 + 2(tau/g - ML/2) l - ML^2/3 = 0, so l = [-(tau/g - ML/2) + sqrt((tau/g - ML/2)^2 + mML^2/3)]/m. Adapted: tau, M, L and m vary; returns l in metres with g = 9.8.

items.title: ความหนาของฟิล์มน้ำในภาชนะปิด
items.source: 2.1 ข: ความหนาของฟิล์มน้ำในภาชนะปิด. Theory 2.1 (b): the vapour's partial pressure P1 - P0 T1/T0 at T1 counts n_W = (P1 - P0 T1/T0) V/(R T1) moles, a liquid volume M_W n_W/rho spread over the sphere's 4 pi r^2 = (36 pi)^(1/3) V^(2/3), so the film was M_W V^(1/3)(P1 - P0 T1/T0)/((36 pi)^(1/3) rho R T1) thick. Adapted: V (L), P0 and P1 (kPa) and the temperatures (Celsius) vary; returns the thickness in micrometres.
items.figure: Theory 2.1 (b): the vapour's partial pressure P1 - P0 T1/T0 at T1 counts n_W = (P1 - P0 T1/T0) V/(R T1) moles, a liquid volume M_W n_W/rho spread over the sphere's 4 pi r^2 = (36 pi)^(1/3) V^(2/3), so the film was M_W V^(1/3)(P1 - P0 T1/T0)/((36 pi)^(1/3) rho R T1) thick. Adapted: V (L), P0 and P1 (kPa) and the temperatures (Celsius) vary; returns the thickness in micrometres.

items.title: อัตราส่วนเวลาให้ความร้อนเมื่อมีน้ำเกาะ
items.source: 2.1 ค: อัตราส่วนเวลาให้ความร้อนเมื่อมีน้ำเกาะ. Theory 2.1 (c): heating at a constant rate, t_B/t_A = (Q_G + Q_W + Q_L)/Q_G = 1 + (1/c_VG)(c_VW + L/(T1 - T0))(T0 P1/(T1 P0) - 1), the water evaporating near T0. Adapted: P0, P1 (kPa) and the temperatures (Celsius) vary with c_VG = 20.8, c_VW = 25.0 J/(mol K) and L = 40.7 kJ/mol; returns t_B/t_A.
items.figure: Theory 2.1 (c): heating at a constant rate, t_B/t_A = (Q_G + Q_W + Q_L)/Q_G = 1 + (1/c_VG)(c_VW + L/(T1 - T0))(T0 P1/(T1 P0) - 1), the water evaporating near T0. Adapted: P0, P1 (kPa) and the temperatures (Celsius) vary with c_VG = 20.8, c_VW = 25.0 J/(mol K) and L = 40.7 kJ/mol; returns t_B/t_A.

items.title: ระยะอัดอากาศในฉับโผงก่อนลูกปอเคลื่อน
items.source: 2.2 ก-ข: ระยะอัดอากาศในฉับโผงก่อนลูกปอเคลื่อน. Theory 2.2 (a)-(b) figure: the bamboo insulates and the push is quick, so the air is compressed adiabatically, P_a L0^gamma = P L^gamma, until PA = F + P_a A: L = L0 (P_a A/(F + P_a A))^(c_V/c_P). Adapted: L0 (cm), F (N) and A (cm^2) vary with P_a = 1.0e5 Pa and gamma = 1.4; returns L in cm.
items.figure: Theory 2.2 (a)-(b) figure: the bamboo insulates and the push is quick, so the air is compressed adiabatically, P_a L0^gamma = P L^gamma, until PA = F + P_a A: L = L0 (P_a A/(F + P_a A))^(c_V/c_P). Adapted: L0 (cm), F (N) and A (cm^2) vary with P_a = 1.0e5 Pa and gamma = 1.4; returns L in cm.

items.title: อัตราเร็วลูกปอที่หลุดจากฉับโผง
items.source: 2.2 ค: อัตราเร็วลูกปอที่หลุดจากฉับโผง. Theory 2.2 (c): the pellet leaves before the rod moves; integrating m v dv = [(F + P_a A)(L/(L + x))^gamma - P_a A - f] dx over the barrel length D gives v = sqrt((2/m)[((F + P_a A)/(gamma - 1))(L - L^gamma (L + D)^(1 - gamma)) - (f + P_a A) D]). Adapted: L0 and D (cm), F, f (N), A (cm^2) and m (g) vary with P_a = 1.0e5 Pa and gamma = 1.4; returns v in m/s.
items.figure: Theory 2.2 (c): the pellet leaves before the rod moves; integrating m v dv = [(F + P_a A)(L/(L + x))^gamma - P_a A - f] dx over the barrel length D gives v = sqrt((2/m)[((F + P_a A)/(gamma - 1))(L - L^gamma (L + D)^(1 - gamma)) - (f + P_a A) D]). Adapted: L0 and D (cm), F, f (N), A (cm^2) and m (g) vary with P_a = 1.0e5 Pa and gamma = 1.4; returns v in m/s.
items.note: L0, D, F, f, A and m vary.

items.title: ระยะ D ที่ให้ลูกปอเร็วที่สุด
items.source: 2.2 ง: ระยะ D ที่ให้ลูกปอเร็วที่สุด. Theory 2.2 (d): the pellet gains speed while the push exceeds the drag, so the best barrel ends where (F + P_a A)(L/(L + D))^gamma = f + P_a A: D = L[((F + P_a A)/(f + P_a A))^(1/gamma) - 1]. Adapted: L0 (cm), F, f (N) and A (cm^2) vary with P_a = 1.0e5 Pa and gamma = 1.4; returns D in cm.
items.figure: Theory 2.2 (d): the pellet gains speed while the push exceeds the drag, so the best barrel ends where (F + P_a A)(L/(L + D))^gamma = f + P_a A: D = L[((F + P_a A)/(f + P_a A))^(1/gamma) - 1]. Adapted: L0 (cm), F, f (N) and A (cm^2) vary with P_a = 1.0e5 Pa and gamma = 1.4; returns D in cm.

items.title: อีเอ็มเอฟเหนี่ยวนำสูงสุดในแผ่นทองแดง
items.source: 3 ก-ค: อีเอ็มเอฟเหนี่ยวนำสูงสุดในแผ่นทองแดง. Theory 3 (a)-(c): the flux through a circle of radius r is pi r^2 B0 cos(omega t), so the emf round it is pi r^2 B0 omega sin(omega t), peaking at pi r^2 omega B0. Adapted: r (cm), B0 (T) and omega vary; returns the peak emf in mV.

items.title: กำลังเฉลี่ยจากกระแสไหลวนในแผ่นทองแดง
items.source: 3 ง-จ: กำลังเฉลี่ยจากกระแสไหลวนในแผ่นทองแดง. Theory 3 (d)-(e): a ring of radius r and width dr has resistance rho 2 pi r/(z dr) and dissipates (pi r^2 B0 omega sin omega t)^2 z dr/(2 pi rho r); summing rings gives z pi a^4 B0^2 omega^2 sin^2(omega t)/(8 rho), averaging to z pi a^4 B0^2 omega^2/(16 rho). Adapted: z (mm), a (cm), B0 and omega vary for copper (rho = 1.7e-8 ohm m); returns the mean power in watts.
items.figure: Theory 3 (d)-(e): a ring of radius r and width dr has resistance rho 2 pi r/(z dr) and dissipates (pi r^2 B0 omega sin omega t)^2 z dr/(2 pi rho r); summing rings gives z pi a^4 B0^2 omega^2 sin^2(omega t)/(8 rho), averaging to z pi a^4 B0^2 omega^2/(16 rho). Adapted: z (mm), a (cm), B0 and omega vary for copper (rho = 1.7e-8 ohm m); returns the mean power in watts.

items.title: รัศมีรูเข็มจากระยะตกของน้ำ
items.source: Lab part 1: รัศมีรูเข็มจากระยะตกของน้ำ. Lab part 1: the horizontal jet falls y in t = sqrt(2y/g) and lands x = ut away, so Q = pi r^2 u = (sqrt(g/(2y)) pi r^2) x and the slope of Q against x gives r^2 = slope sqrt(2y/g)/pi; 0.0518 cm^2/s at y = 5.9 cm gives r = 0.425 mm. Adapted with synthetic ranges x (cm) and flows Q (ml/s); returns r in mm with g = 9.8.

Adapted with synthetic ranges x (cm) and flows Q (ml/s); returns r in mm with g = 9.8.

items.title: ความหนืดของน้ำเกลือจากการไหลผ่านเข็ม
items.source: Lab part 2.1-2.2: ความหนืดของน้ำเกลือจากการไหลผ่านเข็ม. Lab part 2.1-2.2: through the needle alone Q = pi r^4 rho g (h - y)/(8 eta l), so the slope of Q against h gives eta = pi r^4 rho g/(8 (slope) l); 0.0112 cm^2/s with r = 0.425 mm and l = 4.0 cm gives 2.9 mPa s. Adapted with synthetic heights h (cm) and flows Q (ml/s) and the needle radius (mm); returns eta in mPa s (rho = 1030 kg/m^3).

items.title: ความหนืดเมื่อคิดสายน้ำเกลือและเข็มอนุกรมกัน
items.source: Lab part 2.3: ความหนืดเมื่อคิดสายน้ำเกลือและเข็มอนุกรมกัน. Lab part 2.3: the tube (radius R, length L) and the needle resist in series, Q = pi rho g (h - y)/(8 eta_c (l/r^4 + L/R^4)), so eta_c = pi rho g/(8 (slope)(l/r^4 + L/R^4)); 0.0112 cm^2/s with L = 151.0 cm, R = 1.1 mm gives 1.6 mPa s. Adapted: the slope (cm^2/s), the tube length (cm) and the needle radius (mm) vary; returns eta_c in mPa s (rho = 1030 kg/m^3).

Adapted: the slope (cm^2/s), the tube length (cm) and the needle radius (mm) vary; returns eta_c in mPa s (rho = 1030 kg/m^3).

items.title: ความตึงผิวของน้ำเกลือจากหยดน้ำ
items.source: Lab part 3: ความตึงผิวของน้ำเกลือจากหยดน้ำ. Lab part 3: a drop leaves the needle when mg = 1.4 (pi r_o) gamma with the needle's outer radius r_o = r + wall; 50 drops of 1.20 ml with r_o = 0.645 mm give gamma = rho V g/(1.4 pi r_o) = 83.6 mN/m. Adapted: the number of drops, their volume (ml) and the bore radius (mm) vary with a 0.220 mm wall; returns gamma in mN/m (rho = 1030 kg/m^3).
